stages.title: First words
stages.canDo: I can say who is doing what, answer yes and no, and ask a question.
stages.blurb: Who is doing what, yes, no, the question words — and the frames they slot into.

stages.title: Everyday verbs
stages.canDo: I can say what I have and what I do, and change a verb for the person doing it.
stages.blurb: The verbs that carry most sentences.

stages.title: Everyday words
stages.canDo: I can name the things around me with the right article, and say that something exists.
stages.blurb: The nouns and adjectives you will reach for constantly.

stages.title: People and family
stages.canDo: I can introduce myself and the people around me, and join two ideas together.
stages.blurb: The first thing any interview asks about, and the words for the people in your life.

stages.title: Food and drink
stages.canDo: I can ask for what I want in a shop or a café, and say what I do not want.
stages.blurb: Ordering, shopping, and saying no politely.

stages.title: Where you live
stages.canDo: I can say where something is, and say what I like and do not like.
stages.blurb: Your home, the household, and where things are.

stages.title: Work and languages
stages.canDo: I can say what I do for a living, what I have to do, and what I did.
stages.blurb: The most common interview topic of all, and the past tense it needs.

stages.title: Getting around
stages.canDo: I can say how I travel, when, and what I can and cannot do.
stages.blurb: Transport, journeys and holidays — and the verb bracket they pull apart.

stages.title: Health and sport
stages.canDo: I can say how I feel, what hurts, and say no to things properly.
stages.blurb: The body, staying well, and sport — plus the dative these lean on.

stages.title: Free time
stages.canDo: I can give an opinion and say why, in a sentence with two halves.
stages.blurb: Hobbies, reading, media and making things — and the clause that carries an opinion.

stages.title: The year and celebrations
stages.canDo: I can describe people and things in detail — which is the second exam task.
stages.blurb: Seasons, holidays, presents and clothes, with the adjective endings a description needs.

stages.title: Exam ready
stages.canDo: I can hold the interview on any of the published topics, and follow a conversation at B1.
stages.blurb: What is left of the A2 vocabulary, and the listening the exam sets a whole level higher.
